name: Bardic Inspiration
uses: Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per long rest; short rest too from level 5
description: Bonus action: choose another creature within 60 ft that can hear you. It gets a Bardic Inspiration die for the next 10 minutes.

Once in that time, it can roll the die and add the result to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw. It can see its d20 first, but must decide before the DM announces the outcome. A creature holds only one die at a time.
From level 5 a short rest also restores your uses.

name: Song of Rest
uses: Once per short rest, no resource
description: During a short rest, perform soothing music or speech. You and each friendly creature that hears you and regains hit points at the end of that rest gets bonus healing in the die shown.

name: Countercharm
description: Action: start a performance that runs through your next turn. You and each friendly creature within 30 ft that can hear you have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.
It ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced, or if you choose to stop it (no action).

name: Superior Inspiration
trigger: You roll initiative with 0 uses left
description: When you roll initiative and have no Bardic Inspiration uses left, you regain 1 use.

name: Cutting Words
description: When a creature you can see within 60 ft makes an attack roll, ability check or damage roll, spend 1 Bardic Inspiration use and roll the die. Subtract the result from that roll.

You can wait until after the roll, but you must act before the DM says whether it succeeds or before the damage is dealt. Creatures that cannot hear you, or are immune to being charmed, are unaffected.

name: Peerless Skill
description: When you make an ability check, spend 1 Bardic Inspiration use, roll the die and add it to the check.
You can decide after rolling the d20, but before the DM tells you the outcome.

name: Combat Inspiration
trigger: Holder makes a weapon damage roll, or is attacked
description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can use it in battle, in one of two ways.
Damage: roll the die and add it to a weapon damage roll it just made.
Defense: when an attack targets it, use its reaction to roll the die and add the result to its AC against that attack. It can do this after seeing the attack roll, before learning whether it hits.

name: Battle Magic
trigger: You cast a bard spell with your action
description: Cast a bard spell using your action, and you may then make 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Mantle of Inspiration
description: Bonus action: spend one Bardic Inspiration use. Pick up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) creatures within 60 ft; you and each of them must be able to see each other. Each gains temporary hit points (see Temp HP).
Each creature that gains them can at once spend its reaction moving up to its speed; that movement provokes no opportunity attacks.
Temp HP: 5, rising to 8 at level 5, 11 at level 10 and 14 at level 15.

name: Enthralling Performance
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: After you perform for at least 1 minute (song, poem or dance), pick humanoids within 60 ft who saw and heard the whole performance (as many as your Charisma modifier, minimum 1). Each makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is charmed by you.
A charmed target adores you: it praises you to anyone who talks with it and gets in the way of your opponents, but it won't turn violent for you unless it already meant to fight on your side.
The charm lasts 1 hour. Damage to the target ends it early, as does you attacking it or it watching you attack or harm an ally of its own.
A target that saves never learns you tried to charm it.

name: Mantle of Majesty

spells.uses: Only while the mantle lasts, no slot

description: Bonus action: you take on an unearthly, beautiful fey look for 1 minute, concentrating on it as if on a spell. You cast command at once without using a spell slot.
Until it ends, every turn you can spend a bonus action to cast command again, still with no slot. A creature charmed by you fails its save against these commands automatically.

name: Unbreakable Majesty
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Bonus action: take on a majestic presence. It lasts 1 minute and ends early if you are incapacitated.

The first time on a turn that a creature tries to attack you, it makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On a fail it can't attack you this turn: it picks a new target, or the attack is lost. On a success it may attack you, but it has disadvantage on saves against your spells on your next turn.

name: Blade Flourish
trigger: A weapon attack hits during your Attack action
resource: 1 Bardic Inspiration (or a free d6 from level 14)
description: Taking the Attack action on your turn gives you +10 ft of walking speed until the turn ends. If one of that action's weapon attacks hits, you may use one flourish below (only one per turn): spend a Bardic Inspiration use and roll the die.
Defensive Flourish: the roll is extra damage to the target, and you add it to your AC until your next turn starts.
Slashing Flourish: the roll is extra damage to the target and to any other creature you choose within 5 ft of you that you can see.

Mobile Flourish: the roll is extra damage to the target, and you can push it away from you up to 5 ft plus that many feet. Afterward your reaction can carry you, up to your walking speed, into an unoccupied space next to the target (within 5 ft).

name: Master's Flourish
trigger: You use a Blade Flourish option
description: Roll a d6 and use it as the flourish die, so you keep your Bardic Inspiration use.

name: Psychic Blades
trigger: One of your weapon attacks hits a creature
uses: Once per round, on your turn
description: Spend one use of Bardic Inspiration to add 2d6 psychic damage to the hit. You can do this only on your own turn, and no more than once per round.
The extra damage becomes 3d6 at bard level 5, 5d6 at level 10 and 8d6 at level 15.

name: Words of Terror
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Talk privately with a humanoid for 1 minute or more. When the talk is over, it makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. If it fails, it becomes frightened of you or of another creature you choose.
The fear lasts 1 hour. It ends sooner if the target is attacked or damaged, or sees one of its allies attacked or damaged. A target that saves never suspects you tried.

name: Mantle of Whispers
trigger: A humanoid dies no more than 30 ft from you
uses: One capture per short or long rest
description: Use your reaction to seize the dead humanoid's shadow by magic. You hold it until you use it or finish a long rest.
Action: spend the shadow to wear a magical disguise of that person, looking alive and well. It lasts 1 hour, or until you drop it as a bonus action.
In the disguise you know whatever the person would freely tell a casual acquaintance (general background and personal life, no secrets), enough to pass yourself off as them.
Anyone can see through it by beating your Charisma (Deception) check with a Wisdom (Insight) check. You add +5 to your roll.

name: Shadow Lore
description: Action: whisper by magic to one creature you choose within 30 ft; only it can hear. It makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC, passing automatically if it can't hear you or has no language in common with you. If it passes, it hears only mumbling.

If it fails, you charm it for 8 hours. The charm breaks early if you or your allies attack or damage it, or if any of you make it roll a save. It believes you know its most shameful secret, though you learn nothing.

Out of fear, it obeys your commands, but it won't fight for you or risk its life unless it already would. It offers you the favors and gifts it would give a close friend. Afterward it has no idea why it feared you.

name: Additional Bard Spells
description: Adds Tasha's extra spells to the Bard list, so you can learn them as bard spells.
They carry an Optional tag wherever they show.

name: Magical Inspiration
trigger: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die casts a spell that heals or deals damage
description: The creature may spend your die on that spell: it rolls the die, picks one target the spell affects, and adds the roll to the hit points that target regains or the damage it takes.
The die is then used up.

name: Mote of Potential
trigger: You hand out a Bardic Inspiration die
description: A Tiny, intangible, invulnerable mote circles within 5 ft of the creature until the die is used or lost. When the die is spent, the mote adds an effect that depends on the roll:
Ability check: the creature rolls the Bardic Inspiration die a second time and keeps the result it prefers.

Attack roll: right after the die is rolled, the target and any creatures you choose within 5 ft of it make a Constitution save against your spell save DC; on a failure each takes thunder damage equal to the die result.
Saving throw: right after the die is rolled, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to the die result + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

name: Performance of Creation
uses: Once per long rest, then a spell slot (2nd level or higher) per use
description: Action: a nonmagical item of your choice appears in an unoccupied space within 10 ft, resting on a surface or a liquid that can hold it. It is worth at most 20 gp × your bard level and is Medium or smaller. It glimmers, and anyone touching it hears faint music. It vanishes once hours equal to your proficiency bonus have passed.

You keep only one such item: making a new one makes the old one vanish at once. The size limit rises to Large at bard level 6 and Huge at 14. For ideas, see the equipment chapter of the Player's Handbook.

Level 14 (Creative Crescendo): make several items in one use, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 2). Going past that number, you pick which older items vanish. Only one item may be the largest size you can make; the rest are Small or Tiny. The gp limit no longer applies.

name: Animating Performance
uses: Once per long rest, then a spell slot (3rd level or higher) per use
description: Action: bring to life a nonmagical item, Large or smaller, that you can see within 30 ft. It becomes a Dancing Item using your proficiency bonus, friendly to you and your companions and obeying your orders. It lasts 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 hit points or you die.

It shares your initiative and acts right after you. It moves and reacts by itself, but its only action is Dodge unless you spend a bonus action to command it (an action from its stat block or any other). The bonus action you use for Bardic Inspiration can also command it. While you are incapacitated it acts as it likes.
One Dancing Item at a time: animating another makes the first go inanimate.
Stat block: Tasha's p. 29.

name: Unsettling Words
description: Bonus action: pick a creature you can see within 60 ft and roll a Bardic Inspiration die. The creature takes the result off the next saving throw it makes before your next turn starts.

name: Universal Speech
uses: Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot of any level
description: Action: choose creatures within 60 ft, as many as your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). For 1 hour they magically understand you, whatever language you speak.

name: Infectious Inspiration
trigger: A creature within 60 ft succeeds on an ability check, attack roll or save after adding one of your Bardic Inspiration dice
description: Give a Bardic Inspiration die to a different creature (not you) within 60 ft that can hear you. None of your Bardic Inspiration uses are spent.
